title: Vision Metric2 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Open Dental appointments (`opendental:appointment`), Zocdoc bookings (`zocdoc:booking`), vision prescriptions (`vision:prescription`), dental hygiene visits (`dental:hygiene`), and Withings eye-health checks (`withings:eye`).
app: Open Dental appointment exports, Zocdoc booking webhooks, vision prescription sidecars, dental hygiene visit logs, and Withings Vision eye-health readings streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vision:metric2 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in vision metric2 (2) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme vision metric2 (2) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It rates the unusually high or low value moments in your vision metric2 (2) history.
